meta: 3 steps to check breaking news before you believe and share it: the angrier or more scared it makes you, the more you need to pause.

muc.title: The more shocking, the more you pause
muc.text: The angrier or more scared a piece of breaking news makes you, the more you need to pause, because that's when you share by mistake.

muc.title: Step one: ten seconds
muc.text: Step one: stop for ten seconds, notice how you feel, and check who posted it and when.

muc.title: Step two: ask AI
muc.text: Step two: paste it into a chatbot and ask which parts are facts to check and which are opinion.

muc.title: Step three: two sources
muc.text: Step three: find at least two trusted sources reporting the same thing, because AI may not know about very recent events.

muc.title: Save the three steps
muc.text: Save these three steps on your phone and use them on the first piece of breaking news you see today.
